parsed.note_claim: The video depicts a real incident from Aug 25 2026 in Katarniaghat Uttar Pradesh India where a local herd of 5 elephants was caught in strong Kaudiyala river currents near Girijapuri Barrage.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Pilibhit: A joint operation by the Katarniaghat wildlife division in Bahraich and the state irrigation department saved a herd of five wild elephants after they were swept towards the Girjapuri barrage by strong currents in the Kaudiyala river on Tuesday morning.
parsed.reason: The article confirms the date (Aug 25, 2026), location (Katarniaghat/Bahraich), number of elephants (five), and the cause (strong currents in Kaudiyala river near Girjapuri barrage) described in the note.
